title: Who leads, and in which term
note: This is the shape of the answer a test takes before and after killing the leader. The `leader` field is a member id, so it has to be looked up in the member list; a member mid-election answers `leader: 0`, which is why the harness polls until the survivors agree instead of asking once. Across a kill, two things have to change together: `leader` names a different member, and `raft_term` is strictly larger. A new leader in the *same* term would mean two members could both claim that term's entries.
